raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview On ROCm, run decode-only batches of Gated-DeltaNet layers (Qwen3-Next, Qwen3.5-family) through AITER's fused conv1d + delta-rule + gated-RMSNorm gluon kernel instead of three kernels. Requires the AITER kernel PR ([#6488](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6488)) (`fused_gdn_decode_qkvz` with `qkvz_layout`, `query_start_loc`, `out`) ## Claims - One launch per GDN layer per decode step instead of three (conv1d, recurrence, gated norm): 882 → 730 kernels/step - Qwen3.8-27B BF16 TP1 on MI355X, 1024×1024, concurrency 64: **+2.6% output tok/s, −3.0% mean TPOT**; Per GDN layer at 64 tokens: 91 → 70–76 µs. - GSM8K unchanged. Prefill, mixed and speculative batches, CUDA/XPU, quantized models: no behaviour change. ## Validation A/B on one MI355X in the `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly` image of 2026-10-05 (vLLM 92044241a0, aiter 0.1.24.post1 + the companion AITER kernel), 1024×1024 random prompts, 10 × concurrency requests: | Concurrency | Output tok/s Main → PR | Mean TPOT (ms) Main → PR | Median TTFT (ms) Main → PR | |--|--|--|--| | 16 | 959.8 → 989.4 (+3.1%) | 16.10 → 15.65 (−2.8%) | 509.5 → 505.3 (-0.8%) | | 32 | 1669.3 → 1706.7 (+2.2%) | 18.37 → 17.95 (−2.3%) | 954.3 → 958.1 (+0.4) | | 64 | 2801.0 → 2874.1 (+2.6%) | 21.84 → 21.26 (−2.7%) | 1066.3 → 1066.4 (+0.0%) | Per-layer decode kernels, 64-token steps (torch profiler, 1024×64): Before: After: GSM8K (lm_eval local-completions, 5-shot, n = 1319): PR --> 0.7263 flexible / 0.6983 strict main --> 0.7233 flexible / 0.7020 strict Reproduction: ``` # Serve VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --tensor-parallel-size 1 --max-model-len 262144 \ --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --language-model-only --no-enable-prefix-caching --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 # Bench vllm bench serve --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 \ --random-range-ratio 0 --ignore-eos --num-prompts 640 --max-concurrency 64 --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0 # Accuracy lm_eval --model local-completions --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --seed 1234 \ --model_args model=Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,tokenized_requests=False ``` ## Details - `qwen_gdn_linear_attn.py`: on ROCm, `forward_hip` calls a new custom op `qwen_gdn_attention_core_fused_norm_rocm(qkvz, ba, normed_out)` that writes the gated-normed output straight into the `out_proj` input buffer. Decode-only batches (no prefill, no spec, fp32 recurrent state) run the fused kernel; everything else runs the existing `_forward_core_rocm` followed by the layer's norm, so prefill/mixed/spec behaviour is unchanged. - Enablement follows the existing CUDA fused-decode gate (`_fused_gdn_decode_unsupported_reason`): an init-time `_aiter_fused_gdn_decode_unsupported_reason` requires a bf16 model with K = V = 128, 2 or 3 value heads per key head, conv width 4, SiLU gating, bf16 conv cache and bf16/fp32 recurrent state, plus an unquantized `out_proj` (the kernel emits the normed output, so the norm cannot be fused with an `out_proj` input quantization). Unsupported layers log once and keep the current path. No new environment variable: the kernel is used whenever AITER provides it (`rocm_aiter_ops.is_fused_gdn_decode_enabled` in `_aiter_ops.py`). ---
Pull Request Checklist - [X] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

+    def _aiter_fused_gdn_decode_unsupported_reason(
+        self, vllm_config: VllmConfig
+    ) -> str | None:
+        conv_state_dtype, recurrent_state_dtype = self.get_state_dtype()
+        if (
+            self.head_k_dim != 128
+            or self.head_v_dim != 128
+            or self.num_v_heads % self.num_k_heads != 0
+            or self.num_v_heads // self.num_k_heads not in (2, 3)
+            or self.conv_kernel_size != 4
+            or self.norm.activation != "silu"
+            or vllm_config.model_config.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or conv_state_dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or recurrent_state_dtype not in FUSED_GDN_STATE_DTYPES
+        ):
+            return (
+                "the fused AITER kernel requires a BF16 GDN model with K=V=128, "
+                "2 or 3 value heads per key head, conv width 4, SiLU gating and "
+                "a BF16 convolution cache"
+            )
+        if not isinstance(self.out_proj.quant_method, UnquantizedLinearMethod):
+            # The kernel emits the normed output, so the norm cannot be fused
+            # with the out_proj input quantization.
+            return "out_proj is quantized"
+        return None

+    def _forward_core_rocm_fused_norm(
+        self,
+        qkvz: torch.Tensor,
+        ba: torch.Tensor,
+        normed_out: torch.Tensor,
+    ):
+        """``_forward_core_rocm`` + gated RMSNorm into ``normed_out`` [T, H_v, d_v];
+        decode-only batches run the fused AITER kernel."""
+        forward_context = get_forward_context()
+        attn_metadata_raw = forward_context.attn_metadata
+
+        attn_metadata = None
+        if isinstance(attn_metadata_raw, dict):
+            attn_metadata = attn_metadata_raw.get(self.prefix)
+        if attn_metadata is None:
+            v_dim = normed_out.shape[-1] * normed_out.shape[-2]
+            self._warmup_prefill_kernels(qkvz, v_dim)
+            return
+
+        assert isinstance(attn_metadata, GDNAttentionMetadata)
+
+        if (
+            attn_metadata.spec_sequence_masks is None
+            and attn_metadata.num_prefills == 0
+            and attn_metadata.num_decodes > 0
+            and self.kv_cache[1].dtype is torch.float32
+        ):
+            return self._forward_core_decode_aiter_fused(
+                qkvz=qkvz,
+                ba=ba,
+                normed_out=normed_out,
+                attn_metadata=attn_metadata,
+            )
+
+        z = torch.empty_like(normed_out)
+        core_attn_out = torch.empty_like(normed_out)
+        self._forward_core_rocm(qkvz=qkvz, ba=ba, z_out=z, core_attn_out=core_attn_out)
+        # Eager inside the op: run the FLA gated norm straight into normed_out.
+        self._rms_norm_gated_cuda(core_attn_out, z, normed_out)
+
+    def _forward_core_decode_aiter_fused(
+        self,
+        qkvz: torch.Tensor,
+        ba: torch.Tensor,
+        normed_out: torch.Tensor,
+        attn_metadata: GDNAttentionMetadata,
+    ):
+        """Decode-only batch: conv1d + recurrence + gated RMSNorm in one kernel."""
+        num_tokens = attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
+        conv_state = (
+            self.kv_cache[0]
+            if is_conv_state_dim_first()
+            else self.kv_cache[0].transpose(-1, -2)
+        )
+        conv_weights = self.conv1d.weight.view(
+            self.conv1d.weight.size(0), self.conv1d.weight.size(2)
+        )
+        conv_bias = self.conv1d.bias
+        if conv_bias is None:
+            if self._aiter_fused_conv_bias is None:
+                self._aiter_fused_conv_bias = conv_weights.new_zeros(
+                    conv_weights.shape[0]
+                )
+            conv_bias = self._aiter_fused_conv_bias
+        gdn_aiter_fused_gdn_decode_qkvz(
+            qkvz[:num_tokens],
+            ba[:num_tokens],
+            conv_state,
+            self.kv_cache[1],
+            attn_metadata.non_spec_state_indices_tensor[:num_tokens],  # type: ignore[index]
+            conv_weights,
+            conv_bias,
+            self.A_log,
+            self.dt_bias,
+            self.norm.weight,
+            scale=self.head_k_dim**-0.5,
+            norm_eps=self.norm.eps,
+            quant_dtype=None,
+            qkvz_layout=self.qkvz_layout,
+            # Empty query segments mark padded CUDA-graph rows; the kernel skips them.
+            query_start_loc=attn_metadata.non_spec_query_start_loc[  # type: ignore[index]
+                : num_tokens + 1
+            ],
+            out=normed_out[:num_tokens],
+        )
+
     def _forward_core_decode_non_spec(
         self,
         mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor,

+    self._forward_core_rocm_fused_norm(qkvz=qkvz, ba=ba, normed_out=normed_out)
